# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 1.4.x   | :white_check_mark: |
| 1.3.x   | :x: |
| < 1.2.0 | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Usually the secuity issue is a upstream problem so it is upto other develop teams. However, if you find a problem _directly_ in my code, please report it in [issue](https://github.com/Augus1999/bayesian-flow-network-for-chemistry/issues).
